units.CD4202-gemena: Gemena territory (Sud-Ubangi) contains Gemena city, the provincial capital, and the rural secteurs/health zones of Bwamanda, Tandala, Bominenge and Bogosenubea, far from the eastern conflict zones. No Congolese or foreign armed group is known to hold territory here; Gemena city is run by provincial and municipal authorities with PNC commissariats, ANR and an FARDC presence, and rural villages fall under PNC posts, territorial administration and customary chiefs. Insecurity consists mainly of ordinary crime, occasional unrest and land/customary disputes that do not amount to territorial control. Web search was unavailable in this run (search budget exhausted, alternative engines blocked), so the assessment rests on default state presence and general knowledge.
